notes: CRMsnap: mid-market product org (B2B SaaS) - building contextual in-app assistant + semantic personalization. Priority: keep user-visible latency <= 150ms p95 on chat flows; embeddings for search must stay <50ms per request for front-end calls. Started with Hosted API to get quick feedback; impressed with integration speed. POC details: 2-week hosted POC running three representative routes (chat-short, chat-long, embeddings). Key asks: predictable unit economics, ability to reserve capacity for peak ETL windows, and ability to route to lower-cost quantized variants when acceptable. Security: requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logging; will want KMS integration for keys. Workshop notes (12/06): team ran a 90-minute cost optimization session. Focus areas: continuous batching for high-concurrency chat, prefix/KV caching for repeated instruction prompts, and quantization profiles for Llama-3 family to drop cost on non-critical reranking paths. Redwood presented unit economics sheet comparing Hosted vs Dedicated (reserved monthly) across usage bands. Highlights: with batching + KV caching, effective tokens/second improved 2.5-3x on chat-short; quantize int8/awq suggestion reduced GPU memory/cost for rerank jobs by ~40% in model-run simulations. Actionable recs: enable prefix caching for session-based flows, enable dynamic routing policy (hosted fallback -> quantized variant) and trial Dedicated reserved pool for 200 RPS sustained to test cost inflection point. Quotes: "Latency is critical - if we can't hit ~150ms p95 we lose adoption in the product" (VP Product, Maya Chen). "Show me the delta in $/MAU with and without batching - finance needs that for procurement" (Head of Finance). POC ask from Eng: run a 24h Dedicated micro-benchmark if Redwood can provide a temporary reserved node or close simulation. Next steps (short): update pricing scenarios with Dedicated reserved monthly, schedule Dedicated micro-benchmark (target week of 2024-12-23), legal to review DPA (in progress), procurement to confirm budget by 2025-01-10.
